name: divar-mcp
description: Divar (automotive): search_listings, get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_divar_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DIVAR_API_KEY
platform_mcp_divar_api_key.description: API key of a Kenar app (https://kenar.divar.dev/management/api-keys); search needs the SEARCH_POST permission.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: QUOTA: Divar allows this search only 100 times IN TOTAL per app (even published apps) — use sparingly. POST /v2/open-platform/finder/post {category: light (cars), city, query: {brand_model: [model], production_year {min,max}, usage {max}}}; no pagination (up to 100 newest posts). location is a Divar city slug (e.g. tehran); model is a Divar brand_model value (e.g. 'Pride 111 EX'); years are Solar Hijri (e.g. 1400–1403); mileage in km. price.value and vehicles_fields.usage are strings and stay in raw.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET /v1/open-platform/finder/post/{post token} with the API key only (no OAuth needed): category, city, district and data {title, description, price {mode, value}, images, brand_model, …}; absent fields mean zero/false. Prices in rials.
